review:
Wazdan's take on the fishing-collector idea. Gainer symbols play the fisherman: they stay for up to 10 spins, gathering every Cash and Jackpot value beneath them, and multipliers can raise their value.

In Free Spins, Gainers stay for the whole round, Gain Boosters extend them, and Gain to Infinity keeps them active. Cash Out symbols on the top reels collect and pay too. 2,500x Grand, medium volatility, 96.13% RTP. A steadier alternative to Big Bass-style games.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
